commands.cmd: p=$(command -v markitdown) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && markitdown --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" markitdown

d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; markitdown fixtures/greeting.html > "$d/out.md" 2> "$d/err"; rc=$?; cat "$d/out.md"; python3 -c "
import sys
md = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
html = open('fixtures/greeting.html').read()
checks = {
    'title carried over': 'Local browser command check' in md,
    'h1 became a markdown heading': '# Local browser command check' in md,
    'label text kept': 'Name' in md,
    'button text kept': 'Greet' in md,
    'status placeholder text kept': 'Ready' in md,
    'script body not leaked into markdown': 'addEventListener' not in md,
    'raw html tags not leaked': '<h1>' not in md and '<script>' not in md,
}
for k, v in checks.items():
    print(k, ':', v)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(checks.values()) else 1)
" "$d/out.md"; pc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; test "$rc" -eq 0 && test "$pc" -eq 0
